ShortDescription.Value: 把你看到的统统翻译成你的母语。 Translate everything you see into your native language.

Publish.LongDescription:
# **Bridge the Language Gap (BLG)**（中文在下面）
## Description
It's already 2026, and our game still doesn't support AI translation. There are so many fun mods and assets, yet the lack of localization makes them frustrating for many players to use. As everyone knows, much of the text in Cities: Skylines cannot even be selected or copied. Non-native speakers either have to rely on their limited vocabulary or manually translate everything themselves.
So I created this mod (hereinafter referred to as **BLG**) using Qwen3.8-Max. Previous translation mods mostly focused on the game's built-in text and asset names, while BLG can translate **everything you can see**. Whenever text appears on your screen, BLG automatically sends it to the translation engine you choose and replaces it with your target language. All you need to do is wait a few seconds.
BLG's translation scope includes game text, mod settings and UI, asset names and descriptions, in-game overlay text (such as road names and district names), and more. You can enable any combination of these categories.
Up to **50 languages** are supported. While a paragraph is being translated, "···" will appear at the end of the text to indicate that it is currently translating or waiting in the queue.
## Engines
* **DeepL** (requires API key, free tier available) * **Microsoft AZURE** (requires API key and region, free tier available) * **Baidu** (requires AppID + API key, free tier available) * **Google** (Google's free keyless endpoint no longer seems to work. I'll try switching to the official API that requires a key in a future update.)
More AI translation engines will be added in the future.
If you don't want to register for an API key, I also found a rather strange workaround: choose **Microsoft AZURE** and enter **"中国"** as the API key. It works for me, although I'm not sure whether that's related to my location in China. Feel free to give it a try.
## Compatibility
I've already tested BLG together with **I18N EVERYWHERE** and the localization mods that depend on it. Since the interaction order between translation mods can be complicated, here's the simple conclusion:
**Because BLG automatically translates any visible text that isn't already in your target language, it always has the highest priority. Even if another mod overwrites the text later, BLG will translate it again the next time that text appears—unless you never open that interface again.**
Some players may worry about conflicts, but in practice the impact is minimal. BLG automatically skips any text that is already in your target language.
For example, if your game language is English, your target language is Chinese, and you've installed a Chinese localization mod, the localization mod will replace the original English text first. Since BLG sees that the text is already Chinese, it simply skips it instead of translating it again.
The only real conflict occurs if, for example, you want Japanese while you're using a Chinese localization mod. In that case, BLG will overwrite the Chinese translation with Japanese. But I doubt many people would actually use such a setup.
So you can absolutely use both together—for example, let your localization mod translate the base game and road names while BLG handles everything else. I still recommend disabling overlapping translation categories whenever possible.
Other types of mods haven't been fully tested yet, but in theory anything unrelated to text modification should work without conflicts. If you're using mods such as **Write Everywhere** or anything else that may potentially conflict, please leave feedback in the comments.
## Limitations
* In-game overlay text is still an experimental feature. For performance reasons, translations are only applied when you hover your mouse over the text. For example, road names will only appear in your target language while being hovered. * Text embedded inside images or textures cannot be translated (those are pixels, not strings). * Because the game's built-in fonts don't support every language, many less common languages would only display as squares. Therefore, only around 50 fully supported languages are currently available. * Occasionally, a paragraph may fail to translate. Try clearing the cache first. If the issue persists, please send me your log files for analysis.
## Performance Impact
For performance and technical reasons, BLG doesn't scan and translate every piece of text when the game starts. Instead, it uses a lazy translation approach—text is translated only when it becomes visible. According to testing, the impact on frame rate and simulation speed is almost negligible.
You also don't need to worry about retranslating everything every time you restart the game. After the first successful translation, BLG stores the result locally. Unless you clear the translation cache or the original text changes, cached translations will be reused automatically.
## Privacy
Your API keys are stored in plaintext **on your own machine only** (inside the ModsSettings folder under your user data directory) and are sent only to the translation service you choose. This mod does **not** connect to any developer-owned servers and collects **no telemetry or usage statistics**.
## Disclaimer
This mod is currently in **BETA**.
Translations are generated by third-party machine translation services and **are not guaranteed to be accurate**. Incorrect translations, missing translations, or improper terminology may occur. All original text remains the property of its respective authors.
All supported translation services provide free usage quotas (they are **not unlimited**). Since BLG caches every translated string locally, each piece of text is normally translated only once, resulting in very low API usage.
## Feedback
If you encounter any problems, click **Open Log Folder** in the mod settings and upload the generated log files to this mod's discussion page.
## Donation
This is my first mod. If you find it useful, I'd really appreciate it if you could buy me a coffee. ☕
# **拯救语言不通**
## 描述
已经2026年了，我们的游戏居然还不支持 AI 翻译。有那么多有趣的模组和资产，却因为缺少本地化翻译，让玩家在使用时痛苦万分。众所周知，游戏内很多文本都是无法选中复制的，非母语玩家要么依靠贫瘠的词汇量理解，要么只能进行低效的手动翻译。
于是我用 Qwen3.8-Max 做了这个模组（以下简称 **BLG**，不要问我为什么取这个缩写）。此前的大多数翻译模组基本都只涉及游戏本体文本和资产名称，而 **BLG 可以翻译你能看到的所有文字**。当屏幕上出现一段文本时，模组会自动调用你选择的翻译引擎，将其翻译成目标语言，你要做的仅仅只是等待几秒钟。
BLG 的翻译范围包括游戏本体文本、模组选项及模组 UI、资产名称及描述、游戏内叠层文本（如道路名称、区域名称等）等。你可以自由选择启用其中的一项或多项。
目前支持 **50 余种语言**。翻译时，段落末尾会显示“···”，表示该文本正在翻译或等待翻译。
## 支持的翻译引擎
* **DeepL**（需要 API Key，提供免费额度） * **微软 AZURE**（需要 API Key 和 Region，提供免费额度） * **百度**（需要 AppID + API Key，提供免费额度） * **Google**（Google 无 Key 的免费接口似乎已经无法使用，后续我会尝试改为支持官方 Key 接口。）
未来还会接入更多 AI 翻译模型。
如果你嫌注册 Key 太麻烦，我还有一个邪修方法：选择 **微软 AZURE**，然后把 Key 填成 **"中国"** 也可以直接翻译。我不确定这是否和我所在地区（中国）有关，不过你们可以多试几次。
## 兼容性
我已经测试过 BLG 与 **I18N EVERYWHERE** 以及依赖它的本地化翻译模组的兼容性。由于不同翻译模组之间的覆盖顺序比较复杂，我直接说结论：
**由于 BLG 会自动翻译所有看到的、且不是目标语言的文本，因此它始终拥有最高优先级。即使之后被其它模组再次覆盖，只要玩家再次看到这些文字，BLG 就会重新覆盖回来——除非你一辈子都不再打开那个界面。**
我知道有些玩家可能会担心冲突，但实际上影响并不大，因为 **BLG 会自动跳过已经是目标语言的文本**。
举个例子：如果游戏语言设置为英文，目标语言设置为中文，同时订阅了中文本地化翻译模组，那么进入游戏时，本地化模组会先把文本替换成中文。启用 BLG 后，由于它检测到文本已经是中文，因此会直接跳过，不会再次覆盖本地化模组的翻译。
2个模组会打架的情况举个例子：你目标语言选了日文，但又订阅了中文本地化翻译模组，那么 BLG 就会把替换过的中文再次翻译成日文。不过我想，应该不会有人这么无聊吧。
因此，你完全可以同时启用它们。例如，让本地化翻译模组负责游戏本体、道路名称等内容，而 BLG 负责翻译其它部分。当然，我还是建议你在翻译范围中关闭重叠的选项。
其它类型的模组目前还没有全部测试，但理论上，只要与文本修改无关，都不会产生冲突。如果你正在使用例如 **Write Everywhere** 等可能存在潜在冲突的模组，欢迎在评论区反馈兼容情况。
## 限制
* 游戏内叠层文本属于实验性功能。出于性能考虑，目前只有在鼠标划过时才会覆盖翻译结果。例如，道路名称只有在鼠标移到上面时才会显示目标语言，否则仍会显示原语言。 * 图片中的文字、贴图上的文字无法翻译（因为它们是像素，而不是字符串）。 * 由于游戏内置字形并不完整，很多较冷门语言翻译后会直接显示为方块，因此目前仅保留了 50 余种能够正常显示的语言。 * 个别段落可能会出现翻译失败的情况。请先尝试清除缓存，如果仍然无法解决，请把日志发送给我分析。
## 性能影响
需要说明的是，出于性能和一些技术上的考虑，我并没有在进入游戏时扫描并翻译所有文本，而是采用了\*\*懒翻译（实时翻译、实时生效）\*\*的方式。根据测试，对帧率和模拟速度的影响几乎可以忽略。
你也不用担心每次重启游戏都需要重新翻译。BLG 会在第一次翻译后将结果缓存在本地，除非你清除了翻译缓存，或者原始文本发生了更新，否则之后都会直接使用缓存结果。
## 隐私
你的 API Key **仅以明文保存在本机**（用户数据目录下的 ModsSettings 文件夹），并且只会发送给你所选择的翻译服务。
本模组**不会连接任何作者服务器，也不会收集任何统计数据或遥测信息。**
## 免责声明
本模组目前仍处于 **BETA** 测试阶段。
所有译文均由第三方机器翻译接口生成，**不保证绝对准确**，可能存在错译、漏译或术语使用不当等情况。所有原文版权均归其原作者所有。
所有翻译引擎均提供免费额度（并非无限制）。由于 BLG 会将每一段文本缓存到本地，因此同一段文字通常只会翻译一次，实际 API 消耗非常低。
## 反馈
如果遇到问题，请在本模组设置页面点击 **「打开日志文件夹」**，然后将生成的日志文件上传到本模组讨论区。
## 捐赠
这是我的第一个模组。
如果你觉得它对你有所帮助，可以请我喝一杯咖啡吗？☕
Publish.ChangeLog:
v0.30
- Key bindings shown as separate letters (e.g. "W A S D") are no longer sent for translation. - Strings that are nothing but a placeholder (e.g. "{VALUE}") are no longer sent for translation. - When a translation service swallows the placeholder guard marks, that translation is now rejected and the original text is kept, so you no longer see empty boxes in the UI. - Settings are stored in a single file (ModsSettings\Cs2AutoTranslator.json); the extra .coc file is no longer created.
中文
- 空格分隔的键位串（例如 W A S D）不再送去翻译。 - 纯占位符（例如 {VALUE}）不再送去翻译。 - 翻译接口吞掉占位符保护标记时，该条译文判废并还原原文，界面上不再出现方块。 - 设置只存 ModsSettings 下 Cs2AutoTranslator.json 一份，不再额外生成框架的 .coc 文件。
